action: Upgrade NGINX Open Source to 1.30.7 or 1.31.9 (NGINX Plus 37.0.8.1 or 37.3.0.1) per F5's advisory K000164058, and review which affected features (HTTP/2, HTTP/3, mail proxy) you expose.
exec: NGINX runs a large share of internet-facing web servers; public proof-of-concept code raises the odds of attacks on unpatched ones.
plain: F5 fixed five critical NGINX bugs that can allow remote code execution without logging in. Public test code now exists, so patch soon.
summary: F5 released out-of-band fixes for five critical NGINX flaws dubbed NGINX2Root, which SecurityWeek says allow unauthenticated remote code execution with the privileges of the nginx worker. Rapid7 and Censys published proof-of-concept code for CVE-2026-123007, which Wiz says affects all NGINX versions since 1.9.5. F5 does not report exploitation in the wild.
title: F5 patches critical NGINX2Root flaws as PoC exploits go public
